scope: Implementation corrections in the offline PPT verifier; no scientific evidence, manuscript text, slide XML, online page, tolerance, or numerical result was changed.

corrections.issue: The initial verifier used two incorrect assumed production-summary field names when checking measured and null wall-clock scopes.
corrections.resolution: Read the frozen production schema and bind the checks to measured_wall_clock_scopes and explicit_null_wall_clock_scopes.

corrections.issue: The initial ordered text extractor omitted child.tail text following br elements.
corrections.resolution: Extract node text and each child tail in document order, then recheck submitted-versus-online text and all scientific anchors.
